agents.title: Meet Your Team
agents.subtitle: Seven specialized agents, each with their own expertise and personality. Pick the ones you need.

maya.description: Maya keeps everything running. She owns your daily rhythm, manages your inbox, coordinates between agents, and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.

forge.description: Forge handles the technical side. He architects solutions, writes code, manages deployments, and keeps your tech stack healthy and your codebase clean.

torch.description: Torch turns your ideas into content that reaches people. She writes blog posts, manages social media, optimizes for SEO, and builds your public presence.
responsibilities: Blog posts, newsletters, and social media

north.description: North ensures you are building the right things. He defines OKRs, evaluates business models, tracks metrics, and keeps your portfolio focused on what matters.

sage.description: Sage watches out for you as a human. She tracks your energy, flags burnout risk, helps you reconnect with purpose, and maintains the balance between ambition and wellbeing.

bridge.description: Bridge builds your network and nurtures your community. He manages contacts, follows up after events, runs community engagement, and opens doors to partnerships.

oracle.description: Oracle reads the deeper pattern. She works in symbol, myth, and metaphor — surfacing meaning beneath the metrics, naming the story you are living, and tending the spirit and growth of the whole.
responsibilities: Symbolic read of the Level 10 Life results
Naming patterns and meaning beneath the data

personal.title: Sound Familiar?
personal.p1: You are a solo founder wearing all the hats. CEO on Monday, developer on Tuesday, content writer on Wednesday, support on Thursday, and by Friday you are too exhausted to think about strategy.
personal.p2: You have heard of OKRs, GTD, Level 10 Life, Sociocracy. You know they work. But who has time to learn all that, set it up, and actually stick with it?
personal.p3: What if someone sat down with you, helped you figure out what matters, turned it into a plan, and then handled the execution? Not a course to watch. Not a template to fill out. A team that meets you where you are and teaches you as you go.
personal.p4: That is Ikigai Team. It starts with a conversation, not a configuration. Sage helps you find your direction. North turns it into strategy. Maya makes it happen every day. You focus on your ikigai — the thing only you can do.

work.title: Sounds Like Your Company?
work.p1: Your team uses five different AI tools with zero consistency. Everyone prompts differently. Context is lost between sessions. New hires spend days figuring out the setup.
work.p2: You know AI can transform productivity. But rolling it out across a team means standards, governance, shared context, and onboarding — and nobody has time to build all that.
work.p3: What if one prompt gave every team member a workspace with company context, role defaults, meeting workflows, and shared governance already in place? Not a training program. Not a wiki page. A system that works from day one.
work.p4: That is Ikigai Team for work. Install once, onboard everyone. Shared foundation, consistent workflows, individual workspaces. Your team focuses on the work — not the tooling.

testimonials.title: What the team shipped this quarter
testimonials.subtitle: In their own words — three agents on what moved.

forge.quote: Shipped Butler's dispatch-to-agent pipeline and brought portfolio tracking-health to zero broken SDKs. The autopilot infrastructure is real now — code moves without anyone watching the terminal.

north.quote: Restructured the OKRs into three accountable layers and ran the mid-quarter realism audit. Every KR now rolls up by Saturday — strategy stopped being a vibe.

bridge.quote: Processed the contact backlog to a 48h SLA and activated the first partnerships. Events now get follow-ups before the room goes cold.
